semantics.target: Complete current buffer from this event is remembered immediately; pending[key] becomes that buffer (or is removed for empty). No promotion on input alone.
semantics.humanEditing: Passed through; registry currently does not consult this parameter.

semantics.target: Input first records the full current DOM value and updates pending; Commit promotes pending for the exact control key.
Fixed scan reads each sensitive control currently present, sends commit=true; disconnected controls are also sampled/committed. Not a loop over all historical known buffers.

Retire enumerates pending control keys for the retiring page/context prefix; each most recently received nonempty current buffer is promoted then pending removed. All historical known values remain retained, not all promoted.

Find exactly one recorded protected world per current frame; invoke fixed scan(true) in it; wait nonce acknowledgment; then Commit each remaining pending control. No reconstruction of values from destroyed worlds.
pending.TryGetValue(key,out v) selects current pending value. Promotion sets values[v]=COMMITTED; length <=3 marks unavailable and throws existing public error.

If context no longer exists, fail-closed. If context still exists, received event updates its exact pending control. No heuristic rebind; no explicit event-generation sequence discriminator in current product.
1024 distinct values, 64 pending controls, 4096 UTF-16/value, 262144 total UTF-16, 30-minute active lifetime. Failure permanently closes boundary; no eviction.
